summary: The previous convergence run was invalid for its purpose: the loop broke as soon as the queue emptied and any node had decided, so it never ticked past the 100-tick resend interval and the lagging node stayed at 37 for that reason. Submitted a successor (run id 12) that keeps the same lossy phase, seed and reconfigure step but stops only when all five decided indices are equal (or 150 rounds elapse), retaining the agreement and converged_all predicates. This will distinguish a resend-interval lag from genuine non-convergence after a decided StopSign; all existing findings remain unchanged.
